title: Yeshiva Funding Under Threat
body: Israel's Finance and Justice Ministries weigh a total freeze on yeshiva funding amid a High Court ruling on draft evasion. Officials aim to verify no funds go to draft-evading students.

title: Chareidi MKs Face Backlash
body: Chareidi lawmakers tell PM Netanyahu they're under pressure from constituents who yell at them in shuls over the draft law stalemate.
